answer: Every identity pays 25 tide tax each tide for a yarrow stamp, signed onto a mirror ledger, plus a 70 bond. Each tide, auditors check the mirror; unpaid, or a yarrow stamp reused under a second key, loses bond and seat. One fake costs 25 per tide plus 70 locked; 1,000 fakes cost 25,000 per tide, 70,000 locked, 250,000 in ten tides, against 40,000 rewards. Pooled payments fail: one stamp covers one key. Honest agents pay 25 and keep their share.
